prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in new_flow, and sign_in wait_info because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 4 of 7 tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, +4.3%, and +4.4%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 3 of 9 tests (+4.2%, +3.9%, and +2.6%), while the remaining 6 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Daily Routine Setup Flow: Adds an interactive routine selector component on the home intro screen so users configure feeding and break alert schedules before entering desktop mode. (why: Interactive finish flows consistently win in testing (+9.3%, +5.6%), while support receives emails asking how to manage and interact with pets post-onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desk Companion Care Ritual Setup Screen: Adds a new setup screen 'new_desk_routine' right after home intro where users choose focus triggers and desktop break intervals. (why: Finish interactive and setup flows are highly effective (+9.3% in recent tests), and users report confusion about managing companion behavior post-onboarding.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment & Layering Status Wait Info: Displays GPU rendering, window layering, and display permissions status directly on the waiting screen. (why: Support received 3 support tickets about pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open during first view.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Save Protection Reassurance Copy: Updates the headline and body on the sign_in screen to explicitly state that signing in prevents pet resets and protects save data across logins. (why: Sign_in drops to 80.4% conversion and 8 emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray Controls Guidance Hint: Adds a guidance hint on home_intro explaining how to summon, hide, and access system tray controls. (why: Support logged multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Badge Incentive: Adds an exclusive verified owner seal badge on the adoption certificate screen upon finalizing pet setup. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the main funnel (67.2%); adding visual ownership incentives encourages completion.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Desktop Interaction Command Builder Flow: Adds an interactive command key assignment flow on home_intro to let users map custom hotkeys for pet interactions. (why: Interactive finish flows show strong win rates (+9.3%, +5.6%), and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.)
7: [adoption, wait_info] Custom Photo Processing Troubleshooting Wait Info: Displays real-time image validation status and retry tips on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 emails stating custom pet generation fails or looks wrong, causing drop-offs at the adoption stage.)

scores.note: Interactive finish flows have a proven track record (+3.0% average, winning up to +9.3%), though finish step overall drop is moderate (9.6%).
Finish new_screen tests historically underperformed (-1.0% avg), and adding full screens requires major release effort.
Home wait_info shows positive gains (+1.7% avg across 9 tests), matching reported setup issues at low implementation cost.
Sign-in step loses 19.6% of users and has strong support email alignment; copy changes show reliable modest gains (+1.3% avg).
Low cost hint addition addressing real user confusion tickets, though hint changes historically yield modest improvements.
Adoption stage has the largest funnel drop (32.8%), but visual incentive changes have shown negative results in prior testing.
Interactive finish flows consistently succeed (+3.0% overall gain across 7 tests), though creating a command builder requires new code.
Targeting adoption's huge 32.8% drop with direct support mail evidence; wait_info showed strong early potential (+5.2%).
